item.title: Alabama DC wants Tide to use Mendoza’s Heisman as motivation

item.title: Alabama DC Wommack tells what makes the Indiana offense difficult to stop
item.description: Alabama football’s defensive coordinator Kane Wommack provided a detail breakdown of what makes the Indiana offense a challenge to defend while talking to media members on Sunday. item.title: Alabama knows takeaways will be key against Indiana
item.description: Alabama defensive coordinator Kane Wommack will correct anyone who uses the wrong term. The Crimson Tide refers to forced changes of possession as takeaways, not turnovers.
